subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the various instruments used in an aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of instrument panel layout; Safety: Do not touch live components; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee interaction with diagrams.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft instrument?
Name one instrument used to measure altitude.
Why are instruments critical for flight safety?

topics: Definition and purpose of aircraft instruments
development.content:
Definition and purpose of aircraft instruments
Classification of instruments by function
Basic components of flight instruments
Importance of instrument accuracy
Role of instruments in navigation

Primary flight instruments overview
Secondary and supporting instruments
Instrument grouping and panel layout
Standardization of instrument markings
Basic error sources in instruments

topics: Impact of instrument failure on flight
development.content:
Instrument reliability and maintenance basics
Impact of instrument failure on flight
Introduction to instrument redundancy
Future trends in digital instruments
Summary of instrument categories

summary_questions: Explain the difference between primary and secondary instruments.
Describe the consequences of a primary instrument failure.
List three instruments used for attitude reference.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the elements and mechanisms of aircraft instruments to be covered in the next lesson plan.

pft_rows.syllabus: Instrument elements and mechanism: - Elements, mechanisms, lever mechanisms, gears, hair springs, etc.
